description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel component, specifically testing image handling within PDF documents. It includes test setup, document creation, rendering, and saving functionalities.

classes.name: Images
classes.description: A test class that creates an image-based PDF document, renders it, and verifies image handling functionality in the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Create_Hello_World_Images
methods.description: A test method that creates a simple PDF document with an image and footer, renders, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: A helper method that constructs a minimalistic MigraDoc Document with some text, an image, and a footer containing a timestamp.
